_: Regulatory provisions. A summary says what the provision is ABOUT, never what the reader failed to do.

items.summary: Classification as high-risk, by the use the system is put to.
Record-keeping sufficient to trace how the system operated.
Human oversight, including the ability to intervene or interrupt.
Deployer obligations — oversight by persons with competence and authority.
Post-market monitoring — deployed behaviour watched, not assumed.
Serious incident reporting, with a clock that starts on awareness.
Accountability — being able to demonstrate how processing was handled.
Special categories of personal data, and the narrower grounds for handling them.
Decisions with legal or similarly significant effect, made without human involvement.
Security of processing appropriate to the risk.
Data protection impact assessment where processing is likely to be high risk.
Restrict access to cardholder data by business need to know.
